title: Trigraph replacement precedes line splicing

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Basic-source characters with a final newline.
exceptions: UCN creation and missing final newlines are outside this card.
rule: Replace trigraphs before removing backslash-newline pairs.
cpg_consequence: Keep physical source ranges through both transformations.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description:
Input int ab??/
cd; must produce identifier abcd, not ab followed by cd.

title: Comments preserve token separation

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Complete comments between ordinary preprocessing tokens.
exceptions: Directive handling and retained newlines need separate checks.
rule: Replace each comment with a space rather than concatenating its neighbours.
cpg_consequence: Preserve two tokens across a removed comment.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: Input long/**/value; must retain long and value as separate tokens.

title: Reject unfinished preprocessing tokens and comments

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Source ends inside a token or block comment.
exceptions: Do not confuse a complete line comment at end of input with an unfinished block comment.
rule: A source file must not end with an incomplete preprocessing token or comment.
cpg_consequence: Report lexical failure with the physical start location.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: Input int n; /* unfinished must report an unterminated comment; input "unfinished must report an unterminated literal.

title: Block comments do not nest

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

exceptions: Line-comment controls and delimiters inside literals are excluded.
rule: The first closing delimiter ends the comment even if another opening delimiter appeared inside it.
cpg_consequence: Do not maintain a nested block-comment depth.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: Input a/*outer /*inner */b must leave tokens a and b.

title: Argument prescan stops at argument boundaries

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

exceptions: Parameters stringized or adjacent to token pasting bypass ordinary prescan.
rule: Expand an ordinary argument in isolation, then rescan the substituted replacement together with following source tokens.
cpg_consequence: Separate argument expansion from replacement rescanning.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: With #define ID(x) x and #define CALL() 23, ID(CALL)() must expand to 23; CALL alone must survive prescan.

title: Stringization preserves raw argument spelling

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: One stringized argument producing a valid string literal.
exceptions: Invalid resulting literals and ordering among multiple #/## operators are excluded.
rule: Stringize unexpanded argument spelling, trim boundary whitespace, collapse internal whitespace runs and escape quotes/backslashes within literal tokens.
cpg_consequence: Retain raw tokens and whitespace for stringization.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: With #define VALUE 11 and #define STR(x) #x, STR( VALUE +  VALUE ) must produce "VALUE + VALUE", not "11 + 11"; STR("q") must preserve escaped quotes.

title: Active macro names remain unavailable during rescan

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: A replacement encounters the currently expanding macro, including nested replacements.
exceptions: This restriction does not disable unrelated later source occurrences.
rule: Suppress that occurrence and keep it unavailable in later replacement rescans.
cpg_consequence: Track unavailable tokens rather than using only a recursion depth limit.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: With #define LOOP(x) LOOP(x), LOOP(6) must terminate as LOOP(6); a separate invocation must be processed independently.

title: Built-in AND conditionally evaluates its right operand

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Built-in && with operands convertible to bool.
exceptions: Temporary destruction is excluded from the side-effect ordering guarantee; overloaded operators are excluded.
rule: Evaluate left first; evaluate right only when left is true. Complete left-side effects before starting right.
cpg_consequence: Represent a conditional right-hand CFG path and retain executed effects.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: int n=0; bool b=false && ++n; leaves n=0 and b=false. With n=0, (++n==1) && (n==1) yields true and n=1.

title: Built-in OR conditionally evaluates its right operand

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Built-in || with operands convertible to bool.
exceptions: Temporary destruction and overloaded operators are excluded.
rule: Evaluate left first; evaluate right only when left is false. Complete left-side effects before starting right.
cpg_consequence: Do not introduce right-hand effects on the true left-hand path.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: int n=0; bool b=true || ++n; leaves n=0 and b=true. With n=0, (++n==0) || (n==1) yields true and n=1.

title: Sizeof does not evaluate its expression operand

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: A valid sizeof expression with a complete scalar operand type.
exceptions: This does not waive semantic constraints; function types, incomplete types and bit-fields remain outside this positive case.
rule: Determine size without executing the operand expression.
cpg_consequence: Keep the operand for typing without an executable increment or call.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: int n=8; sizeof(++n); leaves n=8. Do not hard-code the numeric size of int.

title: Destroy members and bases in reverse construction order

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Normally completed construction of a class with nonvirtual bases and class-type members.
exceptions: Partial construction, exceptions, arrays and virtual-base ownership need separate treatment.
rule: After the destructor body and its automatic locals, destroy members and bases in reverse order of completed construction.
cpg_consequence: Reverse the semantic construction plan, not written initializer order.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: For class C : B with members M first, second, log destructor calls: C body, second, first, B; swapping written member initializer order must not swap destruction.

title: Only the most-derived destructor destroys virtual bases

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: Destruction of a completed object with a virtual base.
exceptions: Nonvirtual duplicate bases are distinct subobjects.
rule: Destroy virtual bases from the most-derived destructor, not from intermediate base-subobject destructor invocations.
cpg_consequence: Make complete-object versus base-subobject destruction context explicit.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: For V, A : virtual V and D : A, destruction of D must destroy V once, after A, rather than once from A and again from D.

title: Class and typename introduce equivalent type parameters

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

exceptions: Do not generalize this to template-template parameters or dependent qualified names.
rule: Treat class and typename as equivalent introducers of a template type parameter.
cpg_consequence: Preserve spelling while assigning the same parameter kind.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: template<class T> struct A {}; and template<typename T> struct B {}; must each create one TYPE parameter.

title: Type parameters require type-id arguments

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: An explicitly supplied argument corresponding to a type parameter.
exceptions: Additional restrictions on which types are permitted are not exhausted here.
rule: Require a type-id rather than accepting a value expression as that argument.
cpg_consequence: Check parameter kind after template resolution; preserve the offending argument for diagnostics.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: template<class T> struct Box {}; Box<int> good; Box<7> bad; must accept the first and diagnose the second.

title: Vector elements occupy contiguous storage

basis.review_note: Original PDF reviewed for this bounded obligation; see pilot.md.

conditions: A nonempty vector<T> with T other than bool and 0 <= n < size().
exceptions: No claim about empty-vector dereference, one-past subscripting, capacity storage or vector<bool>.
rule: The address of element n equals the address of element zero advanced by n elements.
cpg_consequence: Expose contiguous element storage only within the stated domain.
platform_policy: C++03; no fixed ABI sizes assumed.

proposed_checks.description: For std::vector<int> v(4,9), &v[3] == &v[0] + 3 must hold. Do not use v[4] or an empty vector as a positive check.
